summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short SMR Daily ETF (SMZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund provides inverse (-2x) exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Nuscale Power Corp. (NYSE: SMR) stock SMZ was launched on Feb 10, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
